boardPawnsSideways.title: At a crossroads
boardPawnsSideways.desc: Your pawns can move straight, left and right

boardPawnsDiagonal.title: Partisans
boardPawnsDiagonal.desc: Your pawns now move diagonally and eat in a straight line

boardKingSwap.title: Royal Decree
boardKingSwap.desc: Instead of castling, the king and rook can exchange places (even if there are pieces between them)

boardLavaRank.title: The floor is lava
boardLavaRank.desc: A random horizontal line is covered with lava

boardExtraRank.title: New floor
boardExtraRank.desc: The board becomes higher by 1 line

boardFogOfWar.title: Fog of War
boardFogOfWar.desc: Players only see their pieces and the squares they are attacking.

boardDoubleStart.title: Double start
boardDoubleStart.desc: Pawns from the starting line can move 3 squares forward

boardSprint.title: Sprint
boardSprint.desc: You have 10 seconds to choose a mod instead of 30

boardZebras.title: Zebras
boardZebras.desc: All knights become common: both players move them on their turn. These knights cannot give check or checkmate

boardFisher.title: Fischer Chess
boardFisher.desc: The royal line of both players is shuffled.

boardNight.title: In the darkness of the night
boardNight.desc: For the next 3 moves, pieces can only move onto dark squares.

boardDay.title: In the light of day
boardDay.desc: For the next 3 moves, pieces can only stand on light squares

boardColorblind.title: Colorblind
boardColorblind.desc: All figures are now different colors

boardPawnFront.title: Pawn front
boardPawnFront.desc: All your pawns move forward 1 square if the path is clear

boardCavalry.title: By horse
boardCavalry.desc: All your pawns become knights for 3 moves

boardMirror.title: Mirror
boardMirror.desc: The left and right borders of the board are connected

boardGhostCells.title: Ghost Cells
boardGhostCells.desc: You can only walk through a few random cells, you cannot stand on them

boardAttraction.title: Attraction
boardAttraction.desc: Every 10 moves, all pieces move 1 square to the center of the board

boardVirus.title: Chess virus
boardVirus.desc: After being captured, a piece infects an adjacent enemy piece: it loses one feature

boardInvisibleRegiment.title: Invisible Regiment
boardInvisibleRegiment.desc: Both players do not see the opponent's pawns until they capture or reach the 4th line (for black - up to the 5th)

boardShuffle.title: Shuffle
boardShuffle.desc: Each square of the board randomly becomes light or dark - the alternation of colors disappears

boardTeleport.title: Teleport
boardTeleport.desc: Two random free cells are connected: entry to one = exit to the other

boardVanityFair.title: Vanity Fair
boardVanityFair.desc: Each of your minor pieces (knight or bishop) has a 50% chance of becoming another minor piece

boardMinefield.title: Minefield
boardMinefield.desc: Invisible mines are placed on 1–3 random free cells: the next figure on the mine is destroyed

boardGolconda.title: Golconda
boardGolconda.desc: At the beginning of each move, with a probability of 1%, a pawn, knight or bishop of the player whose turn it is will fall onto an empty square.

boardUnbridledHorse.title: Horse without a bridle
boardUnbridledHorse.desc: At the beginning of the move, with a 5% probability, your horse randomly makes a move to a random available square

boardBaskerville.title: Baskerville Effect
boardBaskerville.desc: For both players: if a player puts 3 checks on the enemy king in a game, the king will die of fear

boardBloodOath.title: Blood Oath
boardBloodOath.desc: When checkmate, the king can eat his piece nearby and take its place to avoid checkmate

boardSilentFile.title: Dumb vertical
boardSilentFile.desc: The pieces on the chosen file cannot give check or mate

boardFourHorsemen.title: 4 horsemen
boardFourHorsemen.desc: The first capture of each knight turns the victim into your piece: both remain on the square until someone leaves

boardReroll.title: Re-election
boardReroll.desc: All players can update the proposed mods until the end of the game

boardPassiveAggression.title: Passive aggression
boardPassiveAggression.desc: Each player must check at least once in 10 of his moves, otherwise he loses; after check the counter is 10 again

boardSkipTurn.title: I'm still thinking
boardSkipTurn.desc: Both players can skip a move and pass it to their opponent

boardTroopFatigue.title: Troop fatigue
boardTroopFatigue.desc: One piece cannot move two moves in a row

boardCombatOptics.title: Combat optics
boardCombatOptics.desc: The bishop, rook and queen move no further than 3 cells without capturing, and without limit when capturing

boardKingOfHill.title: King of the Hill
boardKingOfHill.desc: Visited cells are colored in the player's color; staining more than 48 cells out of 64 wins

boardSecretRoute.title: Secret route
boardSecretRoute.desc: Each player receives a hidden route of three squares; visiting all three brings victory

boardRoyalPilgrimage.title: Royal pilgrimage
boardRoyalPilgrimage.desc: A king reaching the opponent's extreme rank without check brings his player victory

boardMightMakesRight.title: The right of the strong
boardMightMakesRight.desc: A figure can only take pieces not more expensive than itself; the king can take everyone and everyone can attack the king

boardExpeditionaryCorps.title: Survey Corps
boardExpeditionaryCorps.desc: A piece in the opponent's half cannot return to its own half until it has made at least one capture

boardWitnessProtection.title: Witness Protection Program
boardWitnessProtection.desc: Both players secretly choose one of their pieces, except the king; her first take is canceled

boardDeserters.title: Deserters
boardDeserters.desc: Each player secretly has a deserter pawn; on the enemy side it changes color

boardLetterH.title: H
boardLetterH.desc: Make the letter H from 7 of your pieces - win

boardFullCircle.title: Full circle
boardFullCircle.desc: A rook visiting all 4 corner cells brings victory

boardArchitect.title: Architect
boardArchitect.desc: 3–8 walls appear between random adjacent cells: you cannot walk or attack through them

boardBigAssortment.title: Large assortment
boardBigAssortment.desc: Only you choose from 4 mods in the wave until the end of the game; the opponent is still from 3

boardBlindSpot.title: Blind spot
boardBlindSpot.desc: Rival mods are hidden by question marks; yours are visible as usual

boardOnlyEqualsKill.title: Only an equal will kill
boardOnlyEqualsKill.desc: Five captures of pieces of the same type as the captured one bring victory.

boardMarseillesChess.title: Marseille chess
boardMarseillesChess.desc: In one move, the player makes two consecutive movements. In a balanced variation, White makes only one move on the first move

boardInitiativeFear.title: Fear of initiative
boardInitiativeFear.desc: The first player whose piece is eaten additionally selects a mod outside the normal wave once every 3 turns

boardSwamp.title: What are you doing in my swamp
boardSwamp.desc: The piece gets stuck after a move: you can’t move it on your next move (you can with others)

boardCollectiveMyopia.title: Collective myopia
boardCollectiveMyopia.desc: Bishops, rooks and queens cannot move further than 3 squares

boardTerritoryExpand.title: Territory expansion
boardTerritoryExpand.desc: The Z and I verticals appear on the board immediately

boardFrostMap.title: Frosty card
boardFrostMap.desc: Each figure has a frost counter of 0–3 (normal → cold → getting cold → frozen). For a move without a torch next to it +1, next to a torch -1. The piece does not move to 3. Each player has 3 torches; The eaten torch goes to the nearest ally. Just the start of the game.

boardScorchingSun.title: scorching sun
boardScorchingSun.desc: The sun burns 3–6 cells (changes every 5 moves). Heating 0→3 in 3 half-moves of the owner of the figure: on the 3rd the figure dies. Outside the sun, heating drops as the wearer moves

boardTurncoats.title: Renegades
boardTurncoats.desc: Each player has one spy among the minor pieces. You see an enemy spy and can defeat him, revealing him to your side. A spy cannot checkmate “his” king

boardInkBlot.title: ink blot
boardInkBlot.desc: After a capture, a spot remains on the cell for 4 moves: pieces on the spot cannot give check.

boardGravityWell.title: Gravity well
boardGravityWell.desc: Select an empty well cell. Every 6 half-moves, pieces within a radius of 2 move towards him by 1, if free (there is no king).

boardIdealSymmetry.title: Perfect symmetry
boardIdealSymmetry.desc: The board strives for mirror symmetry around the center: asymmetrical pairs of cells are periodically aligned.

boardShadowRight.title: Right of the shadow
boardShadowRight.desc: Each of your figures has a “shadow” - a cell that is symmetrical about the center. Once per game, a piece can step into its shadow instead of moving, if it is free.

boardCenterTax.title: Center tax
boardCenterTax.desc: Entering d4/d5/e4/e5 costs a tax: this piece does not capture on its next move.

boardWalkingCastle.title: Howl's Moving Castle
boardWalkingCastle.desc: Walls appear on the board like the Architect, but every 5 moves each wall moves 1 orthogonally if the path is clear.

boardInvisibleHand.title: invisible hand
boardInvisibleHand.desc: Once every 8 of your moves, your opponent chooses one of your pieces (not the king): your next move with this piece is mandatory, if there is a legal one.

boardRiver.title: River
boardRiver.desc: Select a horizontal river with two fords. You can only cross through fords; You can't stay on the river.

boardForbiddenLetter.title: Forbidden letter
boardForbiddenLetter.desc: A random file is prohibited for entry for 6 moves to everyone except kings. Already standing figures can leave, but not come back.

boardEarnedRest.title: Well-deserved rest
boardEarnedRest.desc: After a series of quiet moves, a piece can declare rest: it does not move for one half-move and cannot be captured.

modeTimeZone.title: Time zone
modeTimeZone.desc: On odd-numbered moves, White’s pieces move as usual, and Black’s pieces move a maximum of 1 square; in even numbers - vice versa.

modeMateVeto.title: Statistician
modeMateVeto.desc: Secretly select an enemy piece - it cannot checkmate (you can attack the king's square).

modeDebtPit.title: Debt hole
modeDebtPit.desc: Capturing enemy pieces increases your debt by 1, and losing a piece decreases it by 1. With a debt of 6, you lose.

modeWasteland.title: Badlands
modeWasteland.desc: After your move, you leave barren land - an enemy piece that steps on the square misses the next move.

modeBus.title: Bus
modeBus.desc: In the event of a stalemate, the player with the fewest pieces on the board wins.

modeShopToken.title: In the name of a higher goal
modeShopToken.desc: Players can sell one of their pieces for a token. The token is spent to cancel one of your moves.

modeSeasons.title: Seasons
modeSeasons.desc: Every 6 turns the weather changes: first Vulcan.

modeBloodFeud.title: Blood feud
modeBloodFeud.desc: If after your capture the opponent does not respond with a capture within 2 half moves, enmity breaks out: you receive a bonus mod.

modePrioritySetup.title: Prioritization
modePrioritySetup.desc: 4 priority squares are marked on the board (2 per side). The first one to occupy all of his own wins.

modeBrokenPerspective.title: Broken Perspective
modeBrokenPerspective.desc: The pawns are promoted to the 7th rank for White and to the 2nd rank for Black.

modeCallOf22.title: Summons '22
modeCallOf22.desc: The board expands to 10x8; Additional pawns appear on the extreme Z and I files.

modeKriegspiel.title: Kriegspiel
modeKriegspiel.desc: Only your own figures are visible. Moves are tried blindly; Captures, checks and impossibility of a move are announced.

modeKingCenter.title: Tour de France
modeKingCenter.desc: The first king to stand on one of the central squares wins.

modeAtomic.title: Atomic Chess
modeAtomic.desc: When captured, a 3x3 area explodes (pawns do not explode). The king is in the explosion zone - his side is defeated.

modeCrazyhouse.title: Crazyhouse
modeCrazyhouse.desc: Captured pieces go into the hand and can be dropped to a free square instead of moving (pawns - not to the outermost ranks).

modeDuckChess.title: Duck Chess
modeDuckChess.desc: After each move you need to move the “duck” to a free cell. You can't walk through the duck or pick it up - it blocks the cage.

pawnSideways.title: Carcinization
pawnSideways.desc: The selected pawn can move 1 square sideways

pawnInverted.title: Diagonal move
pawnInverted.desc: The chosen pawn moves diagonally and eats straight

pawnAlwaysDoubleStep.title: Long stride
pawnAlwaysDoubleStep.desc: The chosen pawn can always move 2 squares forward

pawnRam.title: To ram
pawnRam.desc: The selected pawn moves and eats only forward, not diagonally

pawnAirborne.title: Airborne
pawnAirborne.desc: The selected pawn can jump over the piece directly in front of it once

bishopBoomerang.title: Boomerang
bishopBoomerang.desc: After the next capture, the selected piece immediately returns to the square from which it moved

pawnKamikaze.title: Kamikaze
pawnKamikaze.desc: On your next turn, the selected pawn explodes and pushes adjacent pieces 1 square away from itself, if possible

pawnCaliph.title: Caliph for an hour
pawnCaliph.desc: On your 1st move, the chosen pawn becomes a queen, then a pawn again

pawnSticky.title: Lipota
pawnSticky.desc: An enemy piece that eats the selected pawn will not be able to move on its next move.

pawnPolymorph.title: Polymorph
pawnPolymorph.desc: After capture, the selected pawn becomes the type of captured piece for the next 1 move and moves like it

pawnInheritance.title: Inheritance
pawnInheritance.desc: After the death of the selected pawn, all its mods are transferred to its nearest pawn

pawnRansom.title: Ransom
pawnRansom.desc: When trying to capture the selected pawn, you can destroy one of its mods and cancel the capture. Can only appear if the player already has a pawn with the mod.

pawnForTheKing.title: In the name of the King
pawnForTheKing.desc: If the chosen pawn dies on a mine, your king gets the mod's choice

pawnCamouflageNet.title: Camouflage network
pawnCamouflageNet.desc: A piece surrounded by three or more of your pawns is invisible to your opponent

pawnTrench.title: Trench
pawnTrench.desc: If the selected pawn has not moved for 5 or more of its moves, it can only be captured with two or more attacks

rookSignalFire.title: Signal fire
rookSignalFire.desc: A random cell under the fog of war is permanently unlocked for you

pawnAvengeMe.title: Avenge me
pawnAvengeMe.desc: If the chosen pawn is captured, any adjacent allied pawn can capture the captured piece even with an unusual move

pawnCaravan.title: Caravan
pawnCaravan.desc: Doubled or tripled pawns selected on the same file move forward simultaneously

pawnFaceControl.title: Face control
pawnFaceControl.desc: The enemy piece directly in front of the chosen pawn misses its next move

knightRearing.title: rear up
knightRearing.desc: Other pieces can move onto the square of the selected knight; this horse can't be eaten

knightLongJump.title: Pegasus
knightLongJump.desc: The selected horse jumps only on 3+1, not 2+1

knightSecondChance.title: Second chance
knightSecondChance.desc: When captured, the selected knight returns to the previous square if it is free

knightGallop.title: Gallop
knightGallop.desc: After the move, the selected knight can immediately make a second jump to an empty square

knightDust.title: Dust from under hooves
knightDust.desc: The square from which the selected knight left is inaccessible to anyone for 1 move

knightCentaur.title: Centaur
knightCentaur.desc: The selected knight can also move as a king 1 square

knightTrojan.title: Trojan horse
knightTrojan.desc: After 3 moves, the chosen knight explodes and destroys all surrounding pieces; the countdown is visible from the horse

knightDuel.title: Challenge to a duel
knightDuel.desc: The chosen knight chooses an enemy piece; Until one of the duelists dies, they can only take each other

knightGuard.title: Guard
knightGuard.desc: The selected knight chooses an available square and defends it for 3 moves: it immediately captures an enemy piece placed there out of turn

knightTour.title: Horse riding tour
knightTour.desc: After visiting 8 different cells, the selected horse receives an additional mod

knightDoppelgangerOnce.title: Double
knightDoppelgangerOnce.desc: After the move, the chosen knight leaves an illusion on the starting square once; only her opponent can see her

knightDoppelgangers.title: Doubles
knightDoppelgangers.desc: After each move, the chosen knight leaves an illusion at the start; only the opponent can see them

knightFifthLeg.title: Fifth leg
knightFifthLeg.desc: The selected knight moves to 2+2 squares instead of 2+1

bishopElusive.title: Elusive
bishopElusive.desc: The selected piece can only be captured if it is attacked by at least two enemy pieces

knightStomp.title: Stomp
knightStomp.desc: After the next move of the selected knight, neighboring enemy pawns move away from it if possible

knightSurveyor.title: Surveyor
knightSurveyor.desc: Cells visited by the selected horse are protected from random disasters

knightCornerQuest.title: Not an easy task
knightCornerQuest.desc: If the player’s knights together visit any 3 of the 4 corner cells - victory

knightRideMe.title: Sit on me
knightRideMe.desc: Before the selected knight moves, select an adjacent pawn: it will move with it, maintaining its relative position

knightMagicHooves.title: Magic hooves
knightMagicHooves.desc: The next move of the selected knight creates a portal from the starting square to the final one

bishopHopAlly.title: Jump over your
bishopHopAlly.desc: The chosen bishop can jump over one of its pieces

bishopColorChaos.title: Color chaos
bishopColorChaos.desc: Once selected, the bishop can move to an adjacent empty square, changing the color of the field

bishopInquisitor.title: Inquisitor
bishopInquisitor.desc: Instead of capturing, the chosen bishop can remove one mod from the attacked enemy piece while remaining in place

bishopColorVow.title: Colored oath
bishopColorVow.desc: The chosen elephant is tied to the color of its square and dies on another color; but it can ricochet 1 square from the edge of the board

bishopBrothers.title: Brothers in mind
bishopBrothers.desc: If you have 2+ bishops, the chosen one's move moves all your bishops by the same vector where possible

bishopSanctuary.title: Sanctuary
bishopSanctuary.desc: The chosen bishop chooses an ally other than the king; the next time the defendant is captured, the elephant dies instead

bishopExcommunication.title: Excommunication
bishopExcommunication.desc: Once a piece is captured by the chosen bishop, other enemies of the same type cannot capture it until that bishop's next move.

bishopTithe.title: Tithe
bishopTithe.desc: A modified enemy that leaves the selected bishop's diagonal loses one mod until that bishop's next move.

bishopPilgrimage.title: Pilgrimage
bishopPilgrimage.desc: Having visited all four quarters of the board, the chosen bishop chooses an ally and protects him from the next capture

bishopCrusade.title: Crusade
bishopCrusade.desc: After two captures by the chosen bishop, a random cataclysm is triggered on the board

bishopPost.title: Fast
bishopPost.desc: Three moves of the selected bishop without capturing gives two mod selections in a row

bishopParallelWorlds.title: Parallel worlds
bishopParallelWorlds.desc: The chosen bishop changes places once with an allied piece on the same diagonal

bishopAlcove.title: Alcove
bishopAlcove.desc: The chosen bishop can once create one square beyond the edge of the board and stand on it

bishopGlassCeiling.title: glass ceiling
bishopGlassCeiling.desc: The chosen bishop can jump over one enemy piece instead of capturing; she misses a turn

rookHopAlly.title: Jump over your
rookHopAlly.desc: The selected rook can jump over one of its pieces

rookRam.title: To ram
rookRam.desc: The selected rook can push its piece 1 square further and take its place

rookAstronomicon.title: Astronomicon
rookAstronomicon.desc: The selected rook burns its vertical for 3 of its half-moves: the enemy piece that stands on the burned cell is destroyed; the king cannot stand there. Appears only if there is a rook on the file without enemies; with several - choice.

rookFortress.title: Fortress
rookFortress.desc: The square in front of the selected rook is a strengthening: enemy pawns and minor pieces cannot eat the piece on it

rookStandardBearer.title: Standard Bearer
rookStandardBearer.desc: Pieces on eight squares around the selected rook cannot be moved by forced mod effects

rookCustoms.title: Customs
rookCustoms.desc: For the next 3 turns, enemies cannot stand on a randomly chosen rank or file of a rook if they are not already on it

rookDrawbridge.title: Drawbridge
rookDrawbridge.desc: Allied pieces can pass through the selected rook

rookCurfew.title: Curfew
rookCurfew.desc: The enemy next to the selected rook cannot move away from it for 3 of his moves until the rook itself moves away

rookSiegeCalculation.title: Siege crew
rookSiegeCalculation.desc: If the selected rook can capture the same enemy piece for 3 moves in a row, but does not capture it, this piece disappears

rookFerry.title: Crossing
rookFerry.desc: For the selected rook, the left and right borders of the board are connected, like the Mirror

rookSignalTower.title: Signal tower
rookSignalTower.desc: The selected rook reveals the fog of war on its vertical and horizontal lines

queenKnightStep.title: Horse move
queenKnightStep.desc: The chosen queen additionally moves as a knight

queenHopAlly.title: Jump over your
queenHopAlly.desc: The chosen queen can jump over one of its pieces

queenSplit.title: Separation
queenSplit.desc: The selected queen disappears: a bishop and a rook remain on the square at the same time

queenMatka.title: Uterus
queenMatka.desc: The selected queen cannot eat anyone, but every 3 of your moves a pawn appears around him on a random free square

queenShadowEmpress.title: Empress of Shadows
queenShadowEmpress.desc: The selected queen additionally moves like a knight (2+1), but can only stand on squares of the same color (selected randomly)

queenEscape.title: Escape
queenEscape.desc: If the selected queen is eaten, your bishop or rook will appear on a random free square (50%), without checkmate to the enemy king

queenDelayedSentence.title: Deferred sentence
queenDelayedSentence.desc: The chosen queen marks the enemy being attacked; after the opponent's move, he dies if he is still under the queen's attack

queenTrophyEmbargo.title: Embargo on trophies
queenTrophyEmbargo.desc: Capturing a square controlled by the selected queen no longer gives a reward (compatibility rule; mod waves do not depend on captures)

queenYouShallNotPass.title: You won't pass!
queenYouShallNotPass.desc: An enemy piece that captures the selected queen is also destroyed

kingRoyalDecree.title: Royal Decree
kingRoyalDecree.desc: The selected king and rook are swapped, even if there are pieces between them

kingExtraStep.title: Long stride
kingExtraStep.desc: Your king can move 2 squares in any direction (for example, from e1 to e3)

kingShield.title: King's Shield
kingShield.desc: Once chosen king avoids checkmate by teleporting to a random free square

kingAura.title: Aura
kingAura.desc: The selected king cannot be checkmated with a pawn

kingDoppelganger.title: Doppelganger
kingDoppelganger.desc: All your pawns and queen look like a king

kingThrone.title: The Power of the Throne
kingThrone.desc: While the chosen king is on the throne, check is counted only from pieces no further than 3 squares

kingFamilyUnion.title: Uniting families
kingFamilyUnion.desc: The chosen king can eat his minor piece (knight or bishop) nearby and until the end of the game he can only move like it

kingPrisonerExchange.title: Prisoner exchange
kingPrisonerExchange.desc: You choose your piece taken by your opponent, and your opponent chooses the piece you took; both return to random free cells

kingRemoveEnemyMod.title: Not before they're hanged
kingRemoveEnemyMod.desc: You select and remove one mod from any enemy piece

kingAssemblyHall.title: Meeting room
kingAssemblyHall.desc: Pieces next to the chosen king cannot be the target of a random cataclysm

randomQuarantine.title: Quarantine
randomQuarantine.desc: A random free cell is unavailable for 3–10 moves

randomEarthquake.title: Earthquake
randomEarthquake.desc: Horizontal? moves left or right by 1 square

randomWormhole.title: Worm-hole
randomWormhole.desc: A random empty cell is not available until the end of the game

randomClone.title: Clone
randomClone.desc: Another pawn appears in your half

randomNoQueen.title: Without a queen
randomNoQueen.desc: The enemy queen turns into a knight for 2 of its moves

randomTruce.title: Truce
randomTruce.desc: You cannot take pieces for 3 moves; Checkmate is temporarily not counted

randomMeteorRain.title: Meteor shower
randomMeteorRain.desc: Meteorites fall on 3 random cells, destroying all pieces except kings

randomCensus.title: Census
randomCensus.desc: A random enemy figure with mods will have one random mod disappear

randomExterminatus.title: exterminatus
randomExterminatus.desc: During the next turn for both players: a check to the enemy king instantly kills him

randomGoldenThrone.title: Golden throne
randomGoldenThrone.desc: If your pawn dies, your king chooses his mod

randomLottery.title: Lottery
randomLottery.desc: Your two random non-king pieces switch types

randomPlague.title: Plague
randomPlague.desc: Each turn a figure has a 1% chance of contracting the plague and dying after 3 turns; next to the patient the chance is 10%. Kings can get sick too

randomMutation.title: Mutation
randomMutation.desc: Your random pawn becomes a random minor piece (knight or bishop) of the same color

randomAuction.title: Auction
randomAuction.desc: A random square becomes an auction one: whoever stands on it first will receive 2 mods

randomRightToMove.title: Right of way
randomRightToMove.desc: Choose an enemy piece: on the next move, the opponent must move it if he can

randomFurtherMore.title: Further - more
randomFurtherMore.desc: Nothing is happening now; the next time you select you will be able to update the suggested mods once

randomWordOfHonor.title: The boy's word
randomWordOfHonor.desc: Select a square: if you stand on it on your next turn, you will receive a mod, otherwise you will lose one random mod

randomSymmetry.title: Symmetry
randomSymmetry.desc: For the next 3 moves, your opponent must move with the same types of pieces that you moved before him

randomVeto.title: Veto
randomVeto.desc: Select an enemy piece: the opponent cannot move it for the next 3 turns

randomInitiativeIntercept.title: Seizing the Initiative
randomInitiativeIntercept.desc: The player with the weaker army gets an extra turn without capture, checkmate or checkmate.

randomStrike.title: Strike
randomStrike.desc: Both players cannot move pieces of a random type for 3–10 moves

randomBorderClosure.title: Closing borders
randomBorderClosure.desc: The next 2 moves of the piece cannot cross the middle of the board

randomMyopia.title: Myopia
randomMyopia.desc: Bishops, rooks and queens temporarily see and move no further than 2 squares

randomMagicShutdown.title: Turning off magic
randomMagicShutdown.desc: For the next 3–10 turns all mods are disabled

randomTimeCapsule.title: Time capsule
randomTimeCapsule.desc: The position is maintained; After two turns of each player, the board returns to it, but the earned mods are saved

randomSuicideCapture.title: Suicide bomber
randomSuicideCapture.desc: The next capture destroys both the captured piece and the piece that captured it

randomMeatGrinder.title: Meat grinder
randomMeatGrinder.desc: Both players' next move must be a capture if a capture is possible

randomQuicksand.title: Quicksand
randomQuicksand.desc: 2–5 hidden cells are quicksand. The risen piece does not move for 2–5 moves; the cell opens forever

randomMoveSteal.title: Stealing a move
randomMoveSteal.desc: Once per game, instead of your move, announce a “steal”: your opponent moves, but you choose the piece. Then your turn is skipped.

randomSerialManiac.title: Serial maniac
randomSerialManiac.desc: The third capture by the same piece of yours for the game turns it into a pawn (except for the king).

randomSnailTrail.title: Snail trail
randomSnailTrail.desc: The figure leaves the slime on the care cell for 2 turns: long-range ones move through the slime for a maximum of 1 cell.

randomDisinfo.title: Disinformation
randomDisinfo.desc: You get 3 false cell markers: the opponent sees them as mines, lava or walls, but they are fake before interaction.

randomFamilyContract.title: Family contract
randomFamilyContract.desc: All your pieces of the same random type accumulate a common move counter. On the 6th - a free move with any piece of this type without capturing.

randomKansasHurricanes.title: Hurricanes in Kansas
randomKansasHurricanes.desc: Each vertical receives wind ←/→ for several moves: pawns after moving forward are carried 1 downwind, if free.

randomLoneWarrior.title: One warrior in the field
randomLoneWarrior.desc: A piece (except the king) can take only if at least one allied piece also attacks the victim's square.

randomTwentyOne.title: twenty one
randomTwentyOne.desc: Captures accumulate points based on the value of the pieces. Exactly 21 - bonus mod; busting - penalty: skipping a move or resetting the score.

pawnArchivist.title: Archivist
pawnArchivist.desc: The player chooses one of his pawns. She remembers all the squares she stepped on. Once per game you can return to one of them if the cell is free.

pawnPairStep.title: Pair step
pawnPairStep.desc: The chosen pawn chooses an ally pawn on an adjacent square: while both are alive, a move by one can move both forward by 1 if the path is clear.

pawnFarsight.title: Farsightedness
pawnFarsight.desc: The selected pawn moves only 2 squares forward and shoots 2 squares diagonally forward. You cannot jump over or hit the pieces.

pawnMortar.title: Mortar
pawnMortar.desc: The selected pawn shoots 2 squares directly in front of it every 3 moves: the piece there is destroyed. The timer is visible to both.

pawnSapper.title: Sapper
pawnSapper.desc: The chosen pawn disarms the hidden trap upon entering the square and does not itself suffer. Appears only when traps are active.

pawnHereditaryEdict.title: Hereditary decree
pawnHereditaryEdict.desc: When promoting a pawn, the opponent can only choose a type of piece that he does not currently have on the board.

pawnInfantryShadow.title: Shadow of the Foot Soldier
pawnInfantryShadow.desc: While the chosen pawn is alive, the square directly behind it (towards your edge) is a shelter: the allied piece there is not captured by the pawn.

pawnStarvation.title: Hunger strike
pawnStarvation.desc: The player chooses an enemy pawn. If it does not eat 6 half-moves of the owner, it disappears. The counter is visible to both; taking resets it.

pawnSeed.title: seed
pawnSeed.desc: After the death of the selected pawn, a seed remains on the cell: after 3 full moves, if the cell is free, your pawn is again without mods.

pawnRockPaperScissors.title: Tsu-e-fa
pawnRockPaperScissors.desc: Appears if there are mutually blocking pawns on the board. The player chooses the following pair: rock-paper-scissors until victory; the loser dies. The choice is visible to both.

pawnDoubleLife.title: Double life
pawnDoubleLife.desc: The selected pawn has a hidden second type (knight or bishop). Once per game, for one of your moves, she moves like him, then again a pawn. The type is secret for the enemy.

pawnLittleBrother.title: Little brother
pawnLittleBrother.desc: If there is an enemy non-king piece directly in front of the chosen pawn, it skips the next move.

pawnSpotlight.title: Under the spotlights
pawnSpotlight.desc: If the selected pawn is attacked by enemy pawns for 6 moves in a row and is not eaten, it turns into a minor piece of your choice.

pawnFuse.title: Wick
pawnFuse.desc: The chosen pawn puts a fuse on the escape square: after 2 moves the square explodes (non-kings). Both can see it.

knightMaskSwap.title: Changing masks
knightMaskSwap.desc: The selected minor piece alternates between types after each move: knight ↔ bishop.

bishopMaskSwap.title: Changing masks 1
bishopMaskSwap.desc: The selected minor piece alternates between types after each move: bishop ↔ knight.

knightNonAggression.title: Non-aggression pact
knightNonAggression.desc: Choose your and the enemy's light pieces: they do not attack each other, but they hit the others and are hit by the others.

bishopNonAggression.title: Non-Aggression Pact 1
bishopNonAggression.desc: Choose your and the enemy's light pieces: they do not attack each other, but they hit the others and are hit by the others.

knightKingGuard.title: King's Guard
knightKingGuard.desc: When in check, the selected minor piece automatically eats the checker or closes if it can - this does not waste your turn.

bishopKingGuard.title: King's Guard 1
bishopKingGuard.desc: When in check, the selected minor piece automatically eats the checker or closes if it can - this does not waste your turn.

knightNightWatch.title: Night watch of the horse
knightNightWatch.desc: Only during the fog of war: the selected horse sees everything within a 2-cell radius through the fog.

knightGallopContract.title: Gallop contract
knightGallopContract.desc: Announce 3 route cells. If the chosen knight passes them in order, a random enemy non-king piece dies.

knightTangledTrail.title: Tangled Trail
knightTangledTrail.desc: The selected knight bifurcates for one move: 2 destination cells are selected. On the next move you leave one knight.

knightCustomsPath.title: Customs inspection
knightCustomsPath.desc: When moving with a knight, you choose one of two jumping routes; A random mod is removed from enemies along the route. The route is visible as a line.

knightBucephalus.title: Bucephalus
knightBucephalus.desc: If the chosen knight eats 3 enemy pieces, your king will be able to move as a knight once per game.

knightHoofSmoke.title: Smoke from under the hooves
knightHoofSmoke.desc: All squares on which the selected knight now stands are covered in fog for both players.

knightDonkey.title: Donkey
knightDonkey.desc: The cells visited by the selected knight bind the piece for 1 move (like a “swamp”).

bishopInkTrail.title: ink trail
bishopInkTrail.desc: After the chosen bishop moves along the cells of the path for 1 turn, enemy pawns cannot move there.

bishopGanesha.title: Ganesha
bishopGanesha.desc: After the chosen bishop moves, it becomes a rook, then again a bishop - and so alternates.

bishopHeretic.title: Heretic
bishopHeretic.desc: Only if your pieces are smaller than the enemy's: the chosen bishop splits into 4 pawns on your side of the field.

bishopRelicPower.title: The power of the relics
bishopRelicPower.desc: If the chosen elephant is taken, you have 3 half-moves: stand on the death square and leave - the elephant will be reborn without mods.

bishopBlindingSacristy.title: Blinding sacristy
bishopBlindingSacristy.desc: Capturing the chosen bishop blinds the square: the next one who stands there (not this bishop) does not attack for 1 move.

bishopLayman.title: Layman
bishopLayman.desc: The chosen bishop does not capture the pawns; the pawns don't hit him.

bishopProcession.title: Procession
bishopProcession.desc: The chosen bishop's move can move one allied pawn diagonally by 1 along the same beam, if free.

bishopSchism.title: Church schism
bishopSchism.desc: The chosen bishop is divided into 2 half-bishops: each moves only along one of the two diagonals.

bishopLambs.title: Lambs
bishopLambs.desc: The selected elephant protects all figures within a radius of 1 from cataclysms (for example, meteor shower).

bishopCartographer.title: Cartographer
bishopCartographer.desc: Only during the fog of war: the bishop marks a square on its diagonal - the fog is removed from it forever for you.

rookSeal.title: Seal
rookSeal.desc: The chosen rook chooses the enemy non-king piece to attack: it does not move while the rook is alive or until the rook has made a move.

rookIllDrive.title: I'll take you there
rookIllDrive.desc: The next time the selected rook dismounts and then leaves the end square, a portal is created between the start and finish.

rookCannotHide.title: You can't hide it
rookCannotHide.desc: Only if the opponent hides the modes: the chosen rook reveals the modes of the pieces on its rank and file.

queenCourtIntrigue.title: Court intrigue
queenCourtIntrigue.desc: The selected queen marks an enemy non-king piece outside a radius of 2 from its king: while the queen is alive, she cannot get closer than 2 to her king.

queenFatherDream.title: Which my father never dreamed of
queenFatherDream.desc: If the chosen queen receives 5 buff mods, you win outright.

kingOwnHands.title: With your own hands
kingOwnHands.desc: If your king is within 2 squares of the enemy king, you win. The mod can only be owned by one player.

modeHolyRandom.title: Holy Random
modeHolyRandom.desc: Relevant for both. After a move, the piece has a 25% chance of changing type (same color). The king does not change and no one becomes king.

modeZooShuffle.title: Shuffle at the Zoo
modeZooShuffle.desc: Each player's knights and bishops change places: knights on c and f, bishops on b and g.

modeInsatiableHunger.title: Unquenchable Hunger
modeInsatiableHunger.desc: Queens of both players must take a piece every 5 of their moves, otherwise they die. You can take your own people, except the king.

modeComeOn.title: Come on, come on
modeComeOn.desc: The piece that is the first to capture on the board immediately receives a mod out of the standings.

modeVolcano.title: Volcano
modeVolcano.desc: Every 2 full turns, a volcano explodes on 2 visible random cells, destroying a piece. New cells are then selected.

boardRestlessKings.title: Can't sit still
boardRestlessKings.desc: During each player's next 3 half-turns, his king must leave his square, otherwise that player loses.

randomWarehouse.title: Warehouse
randomWarehouse.desc: The next mod that your opponent loses from a piece, you can transfer to your own piece of the same type (if any); otherwise you wait for the right one.

randomTwilightEclipse.title: Twilight. Saga. Eclipse
randomTwilightEclipse.desc: Random 4 of your pieces become invisible to the enemy for 10 of your half-moves.

randomGestureMirror.title: Mirror of Gestures
randomGestureMirror.desc: Your opponent's next move after yours must end on a square of the same color as your last move.

randomBlackMark.title: Black mark
randomBlackMark.desc: A random enemy piece gets a mark: your next capture of that piece gives you two mod choices in a row.
